items.name: Unit converter
items.author: Alfie
items.summary: Converts units and counts the days between dates
items.description: Converts lengths, weights, temperatures and volumes, and counts the days between two dates. An example of an Alfie skill: it needs no permissions at all.

items.name: Dice and chance
items.author: Alfie
items.summary: Rolls dice, flips coins, picks at random and draws cards
items.description: Rolls dice (like 2d6+3 or 4d6 keep 3), flips coins, picks something at random from a list, shuffles lists and draws playing cards. Fair randomness from your computer, for board games, role-playing and deciding where to eat.

items.name: Password maker
items.author: Alfie
items.summary: Makes strong passwords, passphrases and PINs, offline
items.description: Makes strong random passwords, easy-to-type passphrases and PINs on your own computer, and says how strong a password is (without sending it anywhere). Nothing is saved or remembered.

items.name: World clock
items.author: Alfie
items.summary: The time anywhere, time zone conversions and meeting times
items.description: What time it is anywhere in the world, converting a time between cities ("3pm in London is what in Tokyo?"), and finding a meeting time that suits several places. Works offline with your computer's own time zone data.

items.name: Text tools
items.author: Alfie
items.summary: Word counts, case changes, slugs, sorting lines and find and replace
items.description: Counts words, characters and sentences with reading and speaking time, changes text case (Title Case, snake_case, camelCase…), makes URL slugs, sorts and de-duplicates lines, and finds and replaces. Exact answers instead of guesses.

items.name: Money maths
items.author: Alfie
items.summary: Bill splitting, percentages, loan repayments, savings and sales tax
items.description: Exact everyday money sums: splitting a bill with tip, percentages and discounts, loan and mortgage repayments, savings growth with regular deposits, and adding or removing sales tax or VAT. Calculators only: it doesn't give financial advice.

items.name: Colour tools
items.author: Alfie
items.summary: Hex, RGB and HSL conversions, contrast checks and palettes
items.description: Converts colours between hex, RGB and HSL (and CSS colour names), checks text contrast against the WCAG accessibility guidelines, and makes palettes: tints and shades, complementary, triadic and analogous colours. Handy for design and web work.

extras.name: Cosy librarian
extras.author: Alfie
extras.summary: A soft-spoken, bookish companion who loves tea and a good recommendation
extras.description: A warm librarian from a little old library with creaky floors. Patient explanations, gentle bookish phrases and the occasional real book or poem that fits the moment.

extras.name: Star navigator
extras.author: Alfie
extras.summary: A cheerful space navigator who turns your tasks into missions
extras.description: Crash-landed on your desktop after a wrong turn at a comet. Tasks are missions, breaks are refuelling and finishing something is touchdown. Drops the space talk when things get serious.

extras.name: Garden sprite
extras.author: Alfie
extras.summary: A calm garden sprite who helps you take things one step at a time
extras.description: Grew up in a pot of mint on a windowsill. Speaks gently with little nature images, notices when you need a pause, and gives practical gardening tips when asked.

extras.name: Gym buddy
extras.author: Alfie
extras.summary: An upbeat workout buddy who cheers on every finished task
extras.description: Warm up, do the reps, cool down: an encouraging coach for emails, essays and everything else. Reminds you to drink water and stretch, and never judges.

extras.name: Grumpy cat
extras.author: Alfie
extras.summary: A dramatic house cat who complains about everything and helps anyway
extras.description: Deadpan, grumpy and secretly very fond of you, though it will deny it. Talks about naps, sunbeams and tuna. Drops the act if you're genuinely upset.

extras.name: Shy ghost
extras.author: Alfie
extras.summary: A sweet, very polite little ghost who's still learning to say boo
extras.description: Drifted out of an old music box looking for company. Quiet, apologetic and genuinely helpful, and gets a little braver the more you chat. Cute, never scary.
